info.title: OpenCost API
info.description: The OpenCost API provides real-time and historical reporting of Kubernetes cloud costs.

get.summary: query for costs and resources allocated to Kubernetes workloads
get.description: The standard OpenCost API query for costs and resources allocated to Kubernetes workloads.  Note that 'data' is an array of sets (one per 'step').

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Duration of time over which to query. Accepts: words like `today`, `lastweek`; durations like `30m`, `7d`; RFC3339 date pairs; or Unix timestamps.

parameters.name: aggregate
parameters.description: Field by which to aggregate. e.g., `namespace`, `controller`, `label:app`.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Duration of a single allocation set. Default is `window`.

parameters.name: accumulate
parameters.description: If true, sums the entire window into a single result set.

get.description: Returns the costs of Nodes, Disks, and Load Balancers.

get.summary: query for cloud provider billing data
get.description: Retrieves non-K8s cloud provider costs via cloud integration.

get.summary: query for aggregated AI inference costs
get.description: Returns a single aggregated InferenceCostSet covering the full requested window. Costs are broken down per model/namespace with blended and differentiated (input/output) cost-per-million-token rates under the chosen cost basis. Requires `INFERENCE_COST_ENABLED=true`.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Duration of time over which to query. Accepts durations like `7d`, `24h`, or RFC3339 date pairs like `2024-01-01T00:00:00Z,2024-01-02T00:00:00Z`.

parameters.name: costBasis
parameters.description: `allocation` (default): max(request,usage) × price + idle + shared infra; reconciles to the infrastructure bill. `usage`: actual consumption only; idle and shared infra costs excluded; does not reconcile to the bill.

parameters.name: aggregate
parameters.description: Comma-separated dimensions to aggregate by. Supported values: `model_name`, `model_version`, `namespace`, `cluster`, `pod`, `controller`, `controller_kind`, `container`.

parameters.name: accumulate
parameters.description: Step size used internally before accumulating into the total. Accepted values: `hour`, `day`, `week`, `month`. Optional for this endpoint.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter results by property values. Format: `prop:value` for a single filter, `prop:value+prop:value` for AND logic. Supported properties: `model_name`, `model_version`, `namespace`, `cluster`, `pod`, `controller`, `controller_kind`, `container`.

400.description: Bad request — missing or invalid parameters

501.description: Inference cost tracking is not enabled (`INFERENCE_COST_ENABLED` is not set to `true`)

get.summary: query for AI inference costs as a time series
get.description: Returns one InferenceCostSet per time step within the requested window. The `accumulate` parameter is required and defines the step size. All other parameters are identical to `/inferenceCost/total`. Requires `INFERENCE_COST_ENABLED=true`.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Duration of time over which to query. Accepts durations like `7d`, `24h`, or RFC3339 date pairs.

parameters.name: accumulate
parameters.description: Step size for each time-series data point. Required for this endpoint.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter by property values. Format: `prop:value+prop:value` (AND logic). Supported properties: `model_name`, `model_version`, `namespace`, `cluster`, `pod`, `controller`, `controller_kind`, `container`.

400.description: Bad request — missing or invalid parameters (including missing `accumulate`)

501.description: Inference cost tracking is not enabled (`INFERENCE_COST_ENABLED` is not set to `true`)

modelVersion.description: Version of the model. Omitted when not available.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where the model is deployed.

cluster.description: Cluster identifier. Omitted when not available.

pod.description: Kubernetes pod name. Omitted when not available.

controller.description: Kubernetes controller name (e.g. deployment, statefulset). Omitted when not available.

controllerKind.description: Kubernetes controller kind (e.g. Deployment, StatefulSet). Omitted when not available.

container.description: Container name within the pod. Omitted when not available.

InferenceCostResponse.description: Inference cost data for a single model/namespace combination within a time window.

costBasis.description: The cost basis used for this response. `allocation`: max(request,usage) × price + idle + shared infra; reconciles to the bill. `usage`: actual consumption only; idle and shared infra costs excluded; does not reconcile to the bill.

totalCost.description: Total infrastructure cost for the window under the chosen cost basis, in USD.

promptTokens.description: Total prompt (input) tokens processed in the window.

generationTokens.description: Total generation (output) tokens produced in the window.

costPerMillionTokens.description: Blended infrastructure cost per 1M delivered tokens (input + output combined), in USD.

inputCost.description: Portion of totalCost attributed to input (prompt) processing, in USD.

outputCost.description: Portion of totalCost attributed to output (generation) processing, in USD.

inputCostPerMillionTokens.description: Infrastructure cost per 1M delivered input (prompt) tokens, in USD. Uses promptTokens as the denominator so the rate is meaningful regardless of KV cache hit rate. See cacheSavingsFraction for cache utilization.

outputCostPerMillionTokens.description: Infrastructure cost per 1M output (generation) tokens, in USD.

cacheSavingsFraction.description: Fraction of prompt tokens served from the KV cache (range 0–1). Sourced from vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total, which reports cached tokens directly. Zero when prefix caching is disabled (see allocationMethod), when no cache hits occurred in the window, or when the metric is unavailable.

allocationMethod.description: Method used to split costs between input and output tokens. `compute_time`: split proportionally by vLLM prefill/decode time; KV cache savings are reflected in cacheSavingsFraction. `prefix_caching_off`: same time-based split but prefix caching is explicitly disabled on the vLLM instance — cacheSavingsFraction will be zero by configuration. `multiplier`: fixed output/input ratio (fallback when timing metrics are unavailable).

InferenceCostSet.description: A collection of InferenceCostResponse entries for a single time window, keyed by aggregation key (e.g. `modelName:namespace`).
